summary: Implement Proxy [[GetOwnProperty]] via getOwnPropertyDescriptor trap, descriptor normalization, and target descriptor invariants.

target.notes: Validate revocation, perform GetMethod trap lookup, call the trap with handler as this, then enforce the ECMAScript Proxy invariant before returning.

semantics.trap_result: must be Object or undefined; object is converted with ToPropertyDescriptor then completed
semantics.missing_invariants: cannot hide non-configurable own property or any existing own property of non-extensible target
semantics.reported_invariants: cannot invent property on non-extensible target or claim incompatible non-configurable/non-writable state

caveats: If the trap is absent/undefined, forward to the corresponding target internal method.
Trap property lookup itself can invoke a getter and throw.
A C# interceptor that trusts the trap result without target invariant checks is not semantics-preserving.
